redFlags: Region mismatch: operator is currently referenced by combo pages for pembrokeshire, brecon-beacons, gower, anglesey, llyn-peninsula, south-wales, and mid-wales. It ONLY operates at Oxwich Bay, Gower Peninsula, Swansea. It does not serve pembrokeshire, brecon-beacons, anglesey, llyn-peninsula, or mid-wales — combo pages for those regions referencing this operator are incorrect and should be fixed/removed. Only 'gower' (and loosely 'south-wales' as the broader region containing Gower) are legitimate.
No street address or precise lat/lng could be sourced from the operator's own site or corroborating listings — location is described only as 'Oxwich Bay, Gower Peninsula'.
No Google rating could be sourced (TripAdvisor page blocked by 403 during research; do not invent a rating).
Price range not published on the operator's site; left unknown rather than guessed.

proposedOperatorData.name: Oxwich Watersports
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Watersports equipment hire and RYA training at Oxwich Bay, Gower
proposedOperatorData.description:
Oxwich Watersports is based at Oxwich Bay on the Gower Peninsula, South Wales, offering equipment hire and instruction across a broad range of watersports. Activities include coasteering, stand-up paddleboarding, kayaking, sailing, self-drive boat hire, jet ski safaris, inflatable rides, and RYA-recognised training courses, catering to both casual family visitors and more experienced watersports enthusiasts.

The centre operates exclusively at Oxwich Bay and should not be presented as serving other Welsh regions such as Pembrokeshire, Brecon Beacons, Anglesey, Llyn Peninsula, or Mid Wales.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: Wide range of watersports and RYA training in one of Gower's most sheltered, family-friendly bays
